description: PAID $0.01 USDC. Search 180+ Shopify brand stores by product name or SKU: current price, compare-at price, discount %, in-stock flag, URL, image and a daily 30-day price/stock history. Optional domain filter. No match returns an error with no charge. Returns JSON matching variants: current price, compare-at price, discount percent, in-stock flag, URL, image, and 30-day daily history.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

domain.description: Optional Shopify store domain. Format: a hostname, no scheme. Example: allbirds.com. Omit to search every indexed store.

limit.description: Maximum variants. Format: integer from 1 to 50, as the existing tool text states. Example: 10. Omit for the server's current page size.

q.description: Product name, keyword, or SKU. Format: plain text. Example: wool runner. Required.

name: ecom_product
